# The client

`PyGeoVision()` is the one object most scripts need. It searches and downloads imagery, runs the 41 pipelines, and
carries a *layer* for each area of the package as an attribute. Layers load their heavy dependencies only when you first
use them. Each layer is documented below under the name of the class that implements it.

**Explained in:** [Python API overview](../python-api.md) · [Core concepts](../../getting-started/concepts.md) · [Quickstart](../../getting-started/quickstart.md)

This page documents **19 public classes and functions** in 1 modules.

## `pygeovision`

PyGeoVision — World-Class Geospatial AI Platform.

| Name | Kind | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `PyGeoVision` | class | PyGeoVision — World-Class Geospatial AI Platform. |
| `_LabelingClientProxy` | class | client.labeling — 7+ auto-labeling sources. |
| `_ObiaClientProxy` | class | client.obia — real data for object-based image analysis, through PyGeoVision's own search and download. |
| `_LossesClientProxy` | class | client.losses — geospatial-specific loss functions. |
| `_InferenceClientProxy` | class | client.inference — advanced tiled/batch/streaming inference. |
| `_XAIClientProxy` | class | client.xai — explainability for geospatial models. |
| `_MonitoringClientProxy` | class | client.monitoring — drift detection and performance tracking. |
| `_EdgeClientProxy` | class | client.edge — edge deployment (Jetson, ONNX Runtime). |
| `_CloudClientProxy` | class | client.cloud — cloud deployment (AWS, Azure, GCP). |
| `_FewShotClientProxy` | class | client.few_shot — few-shot learning for geospatial classification. |
| `_MultiTaskClientProxy` | class | client.multitask — multi-task model training. |
| `_AutoMLClientProxy` | class | client.automl — automated hyperparameter optimisation. |
| `_VLMClientProxy` | class | client.vlm — vision-language models (CLIP, Moondream). |
| `_TimeSeriesClientProxy` | class | client.timeseries — spectral-index time series over a stack of images. |
| `_PointCloudClientProxy` | class | client.pointcloud — 3D LiDAR and point cloud processing. |
| `_SegmentationClientProxy` | class | client.segmentation — raster segmentation (buildings, water, general SAM). |
| `_DetectionClientProxy` | class | client.detection — object detection (generic, ships, cars) via native YOLO. |
| `_ChangeDetectionClientProxy` | class | client.change — bi-temporal change detection. |
| `_ClassificationClientProxy` | class | client.classification — scene classification and land-cover mapping. |
